The '''Talhovi system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Juvex sector/Legends|Juvex sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Talhovi]].
